article_thesis: Antibody-conjugated lipid nanoparticles can direct in vivo CAR-T payload delivery toward defined immune-cell populations, making targeting evidence central to translation.
reader_takeaway: Targeting changes where an in vivo CAR-T payload reaches and how its clinical evidence should be judged.

theme.rationale: The clinical-evidence bluebook system emphasizes the relationship between targeted delivery, cohort evidence, and translational confidence without overstating efficacy.

visual_metaphor.relationship: A protected antibody-decorated nanoparticle moves toward a defined immune-cell context while sparse evidence trajectories remain secondary to the delivery mechanism.
visual_metaphor.thesis_explanation: The scene makes targeting and evidence legible as connected but distinct parts of the translational claim.
